exercises.title: Greet yourself
exercises.description: Write a function `greet(name)` that returns a personalized greeting. For example, if you call `greet("Alice")`, it should return `"Hello, Alice!"`.
exercises.test_code:
from exercise import greet

def test_greet():
    assert greet("Ada") == "Hello, Ada!"
    assert greet("Bob") == "Hello, Bob!"
    assert greet("Alice") == "Hello, Alice!"

exercises.title: Say your name
exercises.description: Create a function `say_name()` that prints a greeting with your name. For example, if your name is 'Chris', it should print `"Hello, Chris! Welcome to Python!"`.
exercises.test_code:
from exercise import say_name

def test_say_name(capsys):
    say_name()
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "Hello, Chris! Welcome to Python!\n"
